clips.title: The story
paras: A New Plague is an introductory task in Brill that reveals the Forsaken's overarching strategic ambition. Apothecary Johaan tasks recruits with harvesting the blood of wild darkhounds to lay the groundwork for a virulent pathogen commissioned directly by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

In the damp village of Brill, Apothecary Johaan works on behalf of the Royal Apothecary Society under a mandate directly from the Dark Lady. Sylvanas Windrunner has charged her alchemists with crafting a disease unlike anything Azeroth has ever seen. While the original plague of undeath served the Lich King by slaughtering humanity and binding their souls, this new creation is explicitly designed to annihilate Arthas Menethil and lay waste to his Scourge legions.

Developing a biological weapon capable of destroying the undead requires grim experimentation. Johaan believes that the blood of indigenous beasts, starting with the fierce darkhounds roaming the gloom of Tirisfal Glades, holds vital chemical properties. By harvesting vials of this tainted animal blood, Johaan begins isolating elements to test whether the natural resilience and predatory biology of native creatures can catalyze a lethal contagion.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to Arthas's demise. She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring Arthas's Scourge Army to ruin.
My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, friend? Time is fleeting!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well friend, and I thank you for your efforts.
